q1_issues.issue: (Time sk_moths_2 third_watch) hangs a Time atom on a group entity, but Time atoms are licensed only on an event witness or an event-denoting noun.

(Past sk_moths_2) applies a tense status to a group entity rather than to an event or to a wrapped categorical atom; this copular clause with a time modifier should have reified its state (plus the flat atom) to carry tense and time.

The counted group is typed night_moth although the sentence says only "moth-count", so the narrower kind is imported from discourse rather than read off the words (and the compound moth_count with its genus is dropped entirely).
The sky-cats' stay is emitted as a group-only event with no per-member distribution rule over (PartOf $x sk_skycats_1), although staying is a distributive rather than a collective predicate.

q2_gaps: a count/tally nominal as copular subject with a numeral predicate ("the moth-count at the lantern was seventeen") - the instruction set gives no mapping from a numeric predication on a count noun onto a Cardinality (or Measure) on the counted set
notes: Sentences 1-5 and 7 track the instruction set closely: the BeforeBy gap onto the equinox anchor, entity-attached On for the station, name+kind for "Cliff Path" and "Middle Row", and the collective gather with CardinalityPhrase "a handful". The two bare mass objects are handled inconsistently (mire_essence stays a bare kind constant while mist-light gets a witness), though the later anaphoric mention arguably licenses the witness.
